how: Free Bryant Park Yoga classes run on Tuesday mornings and Wednesday evenings through summer (registration on Eventbrite; bring your own mat), alongside thousands of paid studio classes citywide.

The Collectors Club of New York (philatelic society and library) hosts philatelic talks, a single-frame exhibit competition, Philatelic Foundation workshops open to anyone, and swap days at its Midtown clubhouse.
Numerous Toastmasters clubs meet around the city, e.g. Bryant Park Toastmasters, Astoria Toastmasters and Columbia University Toastmasters, listed on Meetup.
Many Meetup language-exchange groups hold regular in-person sessions, e.g. Langroops NYC Language Exchange, the NYC Spanish/English Intercambio and the Polyglot Language Meetup.
Regular knit and crochet meetups include NYC Knitters, the New York City Crochet Guild, Knitting Around New York and NYC Pints 'n' Purls.
Meetup groups such as Weekend Urban Sketch and the Central Park Sketching & Art Meetup Group run outdoor sketching outings around the city (e.g. sketching the streets of Chinatown).
Gotham Go Group holds weekly Tuesday evening Go sessions at pinkFROG cafe in Williamsburg.
Meetup groups including The New York Chen Tai Chi Chuan Meetup Group and Taiji Form & Qigong Manhattan hold regular tai chi sessions.
Qigong NYC and Taiji Form & Qigong Manhattan run regular qigong sessions through Meetup.
Groups such as Palisades Running Club (Joseph Clarke Trail runs) and Staten Island Hiking Meetup organise trail outings on nearby trail networks.
Many weekly Meetup poker clubs run live low-stakes Hold'em games, e.g. New York Poker Club, Williamsburg Poker Club and Poker Night Out NYC.
GameMaker Meetup Group and IGDA-linked events plus NJ Game Developers host game dev meetups and playtests; dedicated jam events are occasional.
The Amateur Astronomers Association hosts free public telescope sessions one Friday night a month from May to October on the esplanade at Carl Schurz Park, with other pop-up sessions around the city.
The Pennsylvania Avenue Radio Control Society has flown model aircraft for decades from the north end of Floyd Bennett Field and runs an annual Big Apple Jet Rally.
venue: Pennsylvania Avenue Radio Control Society (Floyd Bennett Field)

how: North Cove Sailing teaches keelboat courses (Sailing 101 leading to US Sailing Basic Keelboat certification) on Colgate 26 keelboats from Brookfield Place; Hudson River Community Sailing and SailTime New York also offer lessons.
New York Kiteboarding School gives IKO-certified lessons at Breezy Point, Seagate, Rockaway Beach and Oak Beach, wind and weather permitting.

Alley Pond Adventure Course in Queens has a high ropes course with zip line and climbing elements, with free family programs on Sundays by lottery; Adventures at Governors Island and Area 53 in Brooklyn have further ropes and climbing courses.

Short zip lines operate at Adventures at Governors Island (Flywire Zipline, sometimes closed for maintenance), Sky Chaser at Luna Park in Coney Island and indoors at Area 53 in Brooklyn; longer canopy tours are 1 hour or more outside the city.

An indoor paintball venue was reported in Long Island City (2010 article) and Area 53 in Brooklyn is listed in directories; large outdoor fields such as Liberty Paintball in Patterson are about an hour from the city.
iFLY Yonkers operates a vertical wind tunnel with first-time flyer sessions, about 30 minutes north of Manhattan.
The Horological Society of New York has taught horology to the public since the 1940s through its NYC education programme and lists watchmaking schools and programs.
The Horological Society of New York has met monthly since 1866 for lectures and social events open to watch enthusiasts, ticketed via Eventbrite.
Ikebana Flowers New York (1133 Broadway) runs beginner and advanced ikebana classes (Nageire, Moribana, Jun Fusion), also bookable on CourseHorse and Classbento.
Yuko Gunji teaches 90-minute kintsugi ceramic repair workshops in Manhattan (epoxy method, materials provided), listed by Flatiron NoMad.
An 8-session Introduction to the Highland Bagpipes course is listed on CourseHorse in Manhattan, and Manhattan University's Pipes and Drums recruits beginners with weekly practices.
Brandr Forge in East Flatbush teaches basic and advanced blacksmithing classes and bladesmithing, and Craftsman Ave runs knifesmithing workshops, both listed on CourseHorse.
Celestial Calligraphy offers drop-in calligraphy workshops in Midtown, Flushing Library has hosted weekly Chinese calligraphy series, and New York Zendo has run eight-week courses.
Kathak Legacy Project holds an annual summer immersion at New York Live Arts, and Leela NY offers kathak workshops and classes.
Candle-making classes run at studios such as Nose Best, Classpop! in Brooklyn and Back Porch Soap Company on the Upper West Side, listed on CourseHorse.

J. Bespoke is the NYC-addressed provider of cocktail-making classes listed on CourseHorse (mostly virtual, with kits delivered); in-person bartending and cocktail classes also run at bars and schools but were not confirmed.
Kings County Distillery in Brooklyn runs whiskey tasting classes and Astor Center, Whisky Gourmet and Craftsman Ave offer whisky classes and barrel-aging workshops.
Wine tasting classes run at Astor Center, the Institute of Culinary Education and NYC Wine Company; WSET-accredited certification itself was not confirmed on the listing.
Murray's Cheese on Bleecker Street runs 90-minute mozzarella and burrata making classes with wine, and CocuSocial offers a fresh mozzarella class.
Dickson's Farmstand Meats (Chelsea Market) runs whole-hog and beef butchery classes, with further courses at Fleishers Craft Butchery and The Brooklyn Kitchen.
New York School of the Arts offers a beginner stone carving course (Tuesday afternoons; students bring their own stone) and other stone carving classes are listed on CourseHorse.
venue: New York School of the Arts

how: Noble Desktop and Manhattan Edit Workshop run After Effects and motion-graphics animation courses; dedicated hand-drawn 2D animation classes were not listed.
ABC Languages gives private and group Korean lessons and COEI (West 32nd Street, Koreatown) runs conversational Korean courses.
French Institute Alliance Francaise (East 60th Street) runs French courses from beginner to B2 advanced, with further group courses at ABC Languages.
ABC Languages (26 Broadway) runs an 8-session in-person German course for total beginners plus private lessons.
American Sign Language levels 1-6 are taught at Sign Language Center in Manhattan, ASL NYC in Brooklyn, Brooklyn Brainery and community colleges (ASL rather than a local sign language).
Power Pilates (Third Avenue) teaches mat Pilates teacher-training courses and many studios run drop-in Pilates classes; New York Fencing Academy in Brooklyn lists a Pilates conditioning class.
Peridance Capezio Center runs beginner Street Styles hip hop classes covering popping, locking and breaking.
Joe Coffee (Long Island City) has run an Explorations in Roasting class and Stumptown a Coffee Roasting class, alongside barista and cupping classes.
Pedal boats rent by the hour on Meadow Lake in Flushing Meadows Corona Park and at the LeFrak Center at Lakeside on Prospect Park Lake.
Volo Sports runs adult recreational lacrosse leagues (men's, women's and coed) and drop-in pickup games across the New York metro area.
Manhattan International Netball Club trains weekly (Monday and Thursday) on the Upper East Side and fields teams in Netball America's national league.
The New York Magpies, a men's and women's club in the Eastern Australian Football League, play home games at Tibbetts Brook Park in Yonkers.
Central Park has two lawn bowling and croquet greens north of Sheep Meadow, home to the New York Lawn Bowling Club since 1926; visitors need a Parks Department permit and bring their own bowls.
MeadowBrook Polo Club on Long Island offers a four-week introductory polo course with group lessons, about 20 miles from Manhattan; NYC Polo Club in Patterson runs adult leagues.
Rat Rock and other schist boulders in Central Park offer free legal outdoor bouldering, while the Shawangunks (the Gunks) are a roughly 90-mile drive for roped climbing.
92NY on the Upper East Side runs adult parkour classes (90-minute beginner sessions) as well as youth classes, and Brooklyn Zoo NY and NY Parkour Academy (East River Park) offer further training.
Irish Arts Center and City Music Schools list Celtic harp classes, and teachers such as Anna Lien and Kirsten Agresta Copely give private pedal and lever harp lessons in Brooklyn and Manhattan.
The Games Workshop Warhammer store at 55 East 8th Street has free-use gaming tables, and The Compleat Strategist in Midtown East hosts weekly wargaming and roleplaying nights.
The Hindu Temple Society's Sri Maha Vallabha Ganapati Devasthanam in Flushing is open daily with pujas, festivals such as Navaratri, in-person yoga and meditation, a patasala and volunteering.
venue: Sri Maha Vallabha Ganapati Devasthanam (Ganesh Temple)

how: Coursera and similar platforms offer online courses from universities with free audit access, usable from anywhere in the city.
Spa Castle in College Point, Queens is a large Korean bathhouse (jimjilbang) with hot pools, saunas, and shiatsu and other massage services.
Spa Castle in College Point offers shiatsu and other massage by the hour, among many massage studios across the city.

Animal Care Centers of NYC runs a volunteer programme at its Manhattan, Queens and Staten Island shelters (dog walking, cat socialising, enrichment), with orientations and a six-hour-per-month commitment.
NYC Parks, the Jamaica Bay-Rockaway Parks Conservancy and Surfrider NYC host volunteer shoreline cleanups at Rockaway Beach, with gloves and bags supplied.
NYC Parks GreenThumb supports more than 550 community gardens that welcome volunteers, with free public workdays and no experience needed.
Meetup groups such as 5 BORO Exploration and New York Adventure Club run urban walks and explorations of city sites; access to abandoned sites is not formally organised.
